content.short: Theo Network builds institutional tokenized products including thBILL, thGOLD and thUSD.
content.description: Theo Network issues tokenized versions of institutional financial products, including a Treasury bill product, a gold product and a dollar product, deployed on Monad among other chains. Tokenized Treasuries have been the clearest product-market fit in this category, since they give on-chain capital somewhere to sit that earns a real rate without taking crypto risk.
content.meta: Tokenized Treasury, gold and dollar products built to institutional standards.
